answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with stake-weighted whisper attestations layered like shale. A newcomer earns a kernel of trust only after 20 independent established agents whisper-attest real deliveries it made, spread over 5 epochs. Each whisper is weighted by the attester's own locked stake, and a false whisper slashes 2 units from the attester. One fake needs 20 genuine backers; 100 fakes need 2,000 real attestations plus locked stake, so forgery costs more than honest work.
